lang_en:
New Year in Leh. That was the plan.
Leave approved. Flights in the cart.
Before paying, I opened NakshIQ.
Leh in January. Skip.
Manali in January. Eight out of ten.
And not its busiest month.
I closed the tab.
Same week off. Different mountains.
New Year's morning in Manali.
Her first photo of the year?
Us, wrapped in the same blanket.
Travel intelligence is starting the year in the right place.
NakshIQ.
lang_hi:
नया साल लेह में। यही प्लान था।
छुट्टी मंज़ूर। फ़्लाइट बुक करने ही वाले थे।
पेमेंट से पहले, मैंने NakshIQ खोला।
जनवरी में लेह। स्किप।
जनवरी में मनाली। दस में से आठ।
और सबसे भीड़ वाला महीना भी नहीं।
मैंने वो टैब बंद कर दिया।
वही छुट्टी। बस पहाड़ दूसरे।
नए साल की सुबह, मनाली में।
साल की उसकी पहली फ़ोटो?
हम दोनों, एक ही कंबल में लिपटे हुए।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस मतलब, साल की शुरुआत सही जगह से।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: New Year in Leh? |We *almost* booked it.

shots: s1: Apartment, morning: the man (late 20s) at a desk with a laptop, the woman (late 20s) leaning over his shoulder, a packed duffel bag by the door.
s2: Close-up: his hand pauses over the laptop; he checks his phone instead, screen glow on his face, the screen never visible.
s3: He shows her the phone; she reads and nods, and he closes the laptop.
s4: Manali, morning: the two step onto a wooden guesthouse balcony in winter jackets, mountains beyond, no one else in frame.
s5: Close-up: wrapped together in a thick wool blanket on the balcony, she holds her phone out for a selfie of the two of them, screen not visible.
s6: She lowers the phone and they both laugh; the camera drifts out to the mountain view.
